objective: Split a meaningful request into safe parallel research lanes, merge the findings, then continue implementation without hidden dependency gaps.

tasks.title: Research official documentation
tasks.scope: Official docs, standards, API references, and release notes relevant to the request.
verification_steps: Check citations, versions, dates, and source authority.
tasks.notes: This lane can run in parallel with other research lanes because it writes to its own source note.

tasks.title: Research high-signal discussions
tasks.scope: Stack Overflow, GitHub Issues/Discussions, Reddit, Hacker News, LinkedIn, or other high-signal practitioner discussion.
verification_steps: Treat votes, comments, stars, reactions, and shares as discovery or adoption signals, not standalone factual proof.
tasks.notes: This lane records practitioner signals and contradictions separately from official facts.

tasks.title: Research open-source references
tasks.scope: Reference implementations, maintained repositories, tests, architecture notes, and code examples.
verification_steps: Check repository activity, license, tests, architecture fit, and whether the example is still maintained.
tasks.notes: This lane can run beside official and community research if it writes to a separate note.

tasks.title: Merge research findings
tasks.scope: Fan-in gate that combines parallel research lanes into one evidence-backed synthesis before implementation.
verification_steps: Resolve contradictions or mark uncertainty before implementation starts.
Map each material plan step to source_value_provenance and plan_evidence.
tasks.notes: This is the merge barrier. Downstream implementation depends on this task, not directly on partial research lanes.

tasks.title: Implement after research synthesis
tasks.scope: Source, tests, and deterministic config updates after the synthesis gate is ready.
verification_steps: Run targeted and full tests before merge.
tasks.notes: Implementation should not start from partial research unless the plan explicitly says ship_first and records the deferred synthesis risk.

tasks.title: Document workflow and history
tasks.scope: Docs, prompts, workflows, requirements, specs, request trace, and work summary.
verification_steps: Run workspace index and task board checks.
tasks.notes: Docs can run in parallel only when the implementation and synthesis shape is stable or the touch paths are independent.

merge_gates.title: Research fan-in synthesis gate
acceptance_checks: Every upstream research lane is cited or explicitly marked irrelevant.
Contradictions are resolved or recorded as uncertainty.
Downstream implementation depends on the synthesis output, not on partial lane notes.
merge_gates.notes: Use this gate when multiple research lanes run in parallel and must be merged before implementation.

conflict_controls: Every lane records touch_paths before execution.
Tasks with overlapping touch_paths must be serialized through dependencies or a named lock.
Parallel research lanes write separate notes and only the merge task writes the synthesis note.
Only the primary agent commits and pushes after final merge verification unless a separate branch/worktree policy is documented.
merge_strategy: Run research lanes in parallel, execute the research-synthesis merge gate after all required lanes finish, then allow implementation and docs to proceed from the synthesized plan.
communication_checkpoints: Update coordination status when a lane starts, blocks, finishes, or changes touch_paths.
Stop and re-plan when a lane discovers it needs files owned by another lane.
Do not release downstream implementation until merge gate acceptance checks pass.
verification_steps: Run full final tests/checks after merging all lane outputs.
rollback_plan: Keep lane outputs attributable by task_id.
If one research lane fails, keep completed lane outputs but do not run the merge gate until the failed lane is resolved or explicitly excluded.
If the merge gate fails, re-open only the upstream lane notes or synthesis file that caused the failed acceptance check.
Re-plan dependencies before retrying the failed lane.
source_value_provenance: dependency, touch path, ownership, merge gate, and conflict assumptions <- repository map, git status, project registry, checked workflow docs, and prior coordination status
plan_evidence: parallel research batch choice <- tasks with no dependency edge and no overlapping touch_paths
fan-in merge gate choice <- multiple research lanes must be synthesized before downstream implementation
serialization choice <- dependency edge, shared touch_path, shared mutable resource, or verification dependency
